name: Kazuki Sayuri
source:
Tonosawa Private Academy, Class 1-B

She's the resident trouble-maker in the magic research club, always causing chaos.
They possesses the peculiar ability to be able to talk to objects, but it's completely useless. 
She also works part-time as a waitress at the town's coffee shop to make some money for herself.
